title: Live-Einbruchversuch und Experten-Tipps: Polizei Berlin zeigt wirksame Sicherungstechnik am Tag des Einbruchschutzes am 25. Oktober 2026

extraction.summaryEn: Police Berlin and the carpenters' guild invite the public to a burglary-prevention day on 25 October 2026, with a live break-in demonstration at 13:00. The event is held at the police headquarters foyer.
